description: SCENARIO TRUST cross-scenario consistency sweep (tk_57e0d6adfac63d) — do this workspace's primary scenarios contradict each other? Groups the COMPARABLE presidential-primary scenarios (same mode+party, same calendar…

limit.description: Max scenarios to sweep, most recently updated first (default 20).

simulation_ids.description: Optional — sweep exactly these scenarios instead of the most recent.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: check_workspace_consistency
